_comment: Halo settings. Edit and restart the overlay (and re-run screenshots) to apply. Any subset of keys overrides the baked-in defaults in common.py.

screenshot._comment: Lower max_dim / jpeg_quality = fewer tokens & bytes per screenshot. Raise them if the agent can't resolve small UI. format: "jpeg" (small) or "png" (lossless).

hotkeys._comment: Global Windows hotkeys. modifiers ctrl/alt/shift/win + one key. "" disables. clear=wipe marks, toggle=show/hide overlay, quit=exit overlay.
